# Nextier

> Convert your target audience into deal flow by having more conversations that drive revenue. Nextier starts the conversation, CloudGreet picks up the phone, your team takes the meeting.

## Pages
- [NXTPOST](https://nextiertech11105.github.io/nextier-flow/nxtpost.html): one line in, a month of social posts out, in your voice, scheduled through Blotato across nine platforms. Nothing publishes until you approve it. Floods social, search and AI answers; engagement feeds the Nextier Data Engine (set up at install).
- [Digital Front Office demo](https://nextiertech11105.github.io/nextier-flow/demo.html): Real Estate Agent OS for brokerages, Digital Receptionist for B2B teams, Customer Service for retail. Proof, CRM integrations and booking.
- [Story Mode](https://nextiertech11105.github.io/nextier-flow/story.html): one reply, from first text to booked meeting.
- [3D Flow](https://nextiertech11105.github.io/nextier-flow/): the system as a 3D flow.

## The system
- 01 Data Engine (foundation): finds the property, the owner and the reason; skip traced, auto-tagged, staged ready to launch. Story Mode at dataengine.html#story.
- Signal calendar (dataengine.html#calendar): new event signals land every morning, get skip traced, prepped for Initial SMS and stacked into one block; send evenings launch the freshest first; an owner moving up the distress ladder counts as new again; when the month turns, last month's signals roll to the dialer pool.
- 02 Deal Origination Engine (layer in): initial SMS, reply classification, prioritization, adaptive routed execution.
- 03 NXTPOST (amplify): floods social, search and AI answers.
- Clients own it: their foundational database on DigitalOcean, managed by Nextier; logic, reasoning and contextual intelligence evolve together.

## Facts
- Brokerage rollout: installed in the brokerage's own accounts, managed every week, a seat for every agent with the full toolbox and a digital assistant.
- Works with Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, HighLevel and Follow Up Boss.
- Core engine: Observe, Detect, Classify, Prioritize, Execute, Learn. Monthly review of dispositions, notes and messaging against texts out vs positive replies in. CloudGreet answers all inbound call traffic, mapped to segment channels.
- Book a demo: https://www.nxtier.ai/book/nextier
